meta.name: alfworld-object-placer
meta.description: Places a held object onto or into a target receptacle. Trigger this skill when the agent is carrying an object and needs to deposit it at a specific location to complete a task, such as installing an item on a holder or storing it in a container. It takes the object and destination receptacle as inputs, performing a 'put' action to finalize the object's positioning according to the task goal.

copy.tagline: 将手中物品放入指定容器或位置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在虚拟环境中按指令放置物品
copy.tagline_en: Place a held object into a target receptacle
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to deposit an object at a specific location in a virtual environment

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会执行“放置物体”操作：当你手里拿着一个物体时，它会将物体放到你指定的目标容器或表面上，完成安装或收纳。
howto.when: 当Claude正在执行任务且手里拿着物体，需要把它放到指定的位置（如架子、抽屉）时触发。

say.text: 帮我把螺丝刀放到工具箱里。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude performs a 'place object' action: it puts the held object onto or into a specified target receptacle to complete installation or storage tasks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the agent is carrying an object and needs to deposit it at a specific location (e.g., shelf, drawer) to complete a task.

say_en.text: Put the screwdriver into the toolbox.
Place the book on the shelf.
Put the cup in the cabinet.
